sentences.text: Dustin Lee Hoffman -LRB- born August 8 , 1937 -RRB- is an American actor and a director , with a career in film , television , and theatre since 1960 .
Hoffman has been known for his versatile portrayals of antiheroes and vulnerable characters .

He won the Academy Award for Best Actor in 1980 for Kramer vs. Kramer , and in 1989 for Rain Man .	Academy Award	Academy Award	Best Actor	Academy Award for Best Actor	Kramer vs. Kramer	Kramer vs. Kramer	Rain Man	Rain Man
Widely considered one of the finest actors in history , Hoffman first drew critical praise for starring in the play , Eh ?
, for which he won a Theatre World Award and a Drama Desk Award .	Theatre World Award	Theatre World Award	Drama Desk Award	Drama Desk Award
This achievement was soon followed by his breakthrough 1967 film role as Benjamin Braddock , the title character in The Graduate .	The Graduate	The Graduate
Since that time , Hoffman 's career has largely been focused on the cinema , with sporadic returns to television and to the stage .

Hoffman 's notable films include : Midnight Cowboy , Little Big Man , Straw Dogs , Papillon , Lenny , Marathon Man , All the President 's Men , Kramer vs. Kramer , Tootsie , Rain Man , Hook , and Wag the Dog .	Kramer vs. Kramer	Kramer vs. Kramer	Rain Man	Rain Man	Midnight Cowboy	Midnight Cowboy	Little Big Man	Little Big Man (film)	Straw Dogs	Straw Dogs (1971 film)	Papillon	Papillon (film)	Lenny	Lenny (film)	Marathon Man	Marathon Man (film)	Tootsie	Tootsie	Hook	Hook (film)	Wag the Dog	Wag the Dog
He made his directorial debut in 2012 , with Quartet .	Quartet	Quartet (2012 film)

Along with 2 Academy Award wins , Hoffman has been nominated for 5 additional Academy Awards , and he was nominated for 13 Golden Globes , winning 6 -LRB- including an honorary award -RRB- .	Academy Award	Academy Award	honorary award	Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award
